facility.name: Jeanette's Little Haven Enrichment Center
facility.days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Transportation to/from School ,Weekend Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 6868 WALLING LN, DALLAS, TX, 75231

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was tasked as a result of a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient. A child left the playground unsupervised and was alone in the parking lot for five minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not had monthly fire drills. The last documented drill was in April 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: One playground with a loose fill depth requirement of 9 inches has loose fill at about 4 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A two-month-old infant was placed with a blanket in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver is missing 20 hours of annual training and one caregiver is missing 18 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: In one clasroom the youngest child was two months and the oldest child was 25 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: An infant who cannot roll over was placed on their stomach in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: One playground with a loose fill depth requirement of six inches has about 4 inches of loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: Sheltering drills are not practiced four times a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: Sheltering drills are not being practiced four times a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three out of 10 personnel files reviewed do not have current pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Two of the 10 caregiver files evaluated have 0 out of 24 required annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Three of the 10 personnel files reviewed are not current in pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was pulled as part of an investigation and found deficient. A caregiver was observed on surveillance hitting on child and pulling the child up by their arm in an inappropriate manner to avoid being stepped on by other children in the class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. A caregiver under the age of 18 works with children and has not enrolled in or completed a child care career related program with their high school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Three of the nine employee records reviewed did not have current first aid training available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Three of the nine employee files reviewed do not have CPR available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver was observed hitting a child with an object at naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing Before Feeding a Child: A caregiver was observed handling trash and then feeding a child with her bare hands without washing them first.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing Before Feeding a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child was observed throwing a diaper into the trash.  The caregiver neglected to wash the child's hands afterwards
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids: A caregiver was observed failing to wash hands after wiping noses and changing diapers in class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: A caregiver was observed allowing children to watch a phone.  The children did not appear to be participating in a related activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver is missing 16 hours of annual training. Another caregiver is missing 10 hours of annual training and the center director is missing 17 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Drivers were unable to locate parent's names and telephone numbers and emergency telephone numbers for each child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The electronic safety alarm in one vehicle has not properly worked in at least 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was present with children and counted in ratio without an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility: One bus does not have identifying information for the school labeled on or inside of the bus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: Equipment that was holding water was not dumped before children went outside. This was corrected at inspection when the water was dumped out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: In one classroom, a child was changed on their napping cot. The cot was not thoroughly cleaned after diapering. In another classroom, a child was changed on the diaper changing station. The diaper changing station was not thoroughly cleaned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Caregivers in one classroom are unaware of a daily schedule for the room. A daily schedule was not posted in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Two children were observed not being prompted to wash hands after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Two caregivers were observed not washing their hands after diapering a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Drivers were unable to locate emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One classroom was observed out of ratio during the inspection. The SAG of the class was three years old. There were 17 children with one caregiver. The operation was over ratio by two.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: When reviewing the directors file, only 25 of the 30 required annual training hours were available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One Cargiver file reviewed only had 14 of the 24 required annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Four children files reviewed did not have the required information needed for emergency care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and was in deficient.  Video surveillance provided showed a caregiver had pushed a child in the face, thumping children on the ear, and forcing them to put their head on the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Three staff members did not have current CPR/ First aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Five staff had not completed the required training hours for the evolution year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
